scenarios.behavior: Fail-closed. Abort enrollment/verification. Zeroize DEK in memory. Return error to caller.
Fail-closed. Log critical security configuration alert with correlation ID. No retries.

scenarios.trigger: Specified CryptoKeyVersion state is DISABLED or DESTROYED
scenarios.behavior: Fail-closed. Reject decryption. Trigger administrator key rotation alert.

scenarios.trigger: Key resource path does not exist (404 NOT_FOUND)
scenarios.behavior: Fail-closed. Configuration error logged; DEK zeroized.
Fail-closed. Retry with jitter; if exhausted, return HTTP 503 service unavailable.

scenarios.trigger: Corrupted protobuf or truncated wrapped DEK returned by API
scenarios.behavior: Fail-closed. Discard buffer, throw validation error, zeroize DEK.

scenarios.trigger: Transient failures persist across 3 consecutive retries
scenarios.behavior: Fail-closed. Release concurrency lease, log error with correlation ID, notify client.

scenarios.trigger: Process crashes after DEK wrap but before Firestore transaction commit
scenarios.behavior: Idempotent lease in Firestore expires after 60s. Client retries with fresh challenge. Zero dangling state.

scenarios.trigger: SIGTERM or container eviction during active request
scenarios.behavior: RAM contents wiped on process termination. Zero plaintext keys retained.

scenarios.trigger: Record wrapped with Key Version 1; KMS rotated to Version 2
scenarios.behavior: Cloud KMS unwrap uses key version specified in envelope metadata. Decryption succeeds seamlessly.

scenarios.trigger: Persisted ciphertext or auth tag corrupted by storage error
scenarios.behavior: GCM tag mismatch halts decryption. Original record preserved untouched. Non-biometric KYC flow offered to worker.
